about.name: Rythm Jagga
about.title: Creative Technologist & Software Architect
about.tagline: Architecting high-performance digital experiences through engineering precision and luxury design.
about.quote: “Do not judge me by my successes, judge me by how many times I fell down and got back up again.”
about.bio: I bridge the gap between complex software engineering and high-fashion visual aesthetics. Specializing in full-stack Next.js applications, 60FPS canvas animations, and resilient cloud architecture, I turn bold creative visions into immaculate interactive reality.

experiences.description: Architected full-screen 60FPS frame animation suites, custom Web Audio synthesis engines, and high-conversion luxury web applications for premium global clients.
Scaled Next.js web platforms to millions of monthly active users. Reduced bundle sizes by 40% and optimized canvas rendering loops for high-DPI displays.
Engineered responsive component libraries, interactive data visualizations, and micro-animation design systems.

projects.title: Cinematic Canvas Scroll Suite
projects.description: A 240-frame high-performance HTML5 Canvas animation system with object-cover scaling, DPR optimization, and Web Audio API scroll synchronization.

projects.title: Luxury Brand Digital Showcase
projects.description: A high-fashion luxury digital experience with glassmorphic cards, gold calligraphic typography, and real-time backend content management.
